```text
124	-- Create function to get chunks without embeddings
125	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_chunks_without_embeddings(workspace_id_param uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid) RETURNS TABLE(
126	        id uuid,
127	        exchange_id uuid,
128	        content text,
129	        metadata jsonb
130	    ) LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ BEGIN RETURN QUERY
131	SELECT ec.id,
132	    ec.exchange_id,
133	    ec.content,
134	    ec.metadata
135	FROM exchange_chunks ec
136	    JOIN exchanges e ON ec.exchange_id = e.id
137	    JOIN sessions s ON e.session_id = s.id
138	    LEFT JOIN chunk_embeddings ce ON ce.chunk_id = ec.id
139	WHERE ce.id IS NULL
140	    AND (
141	        workspace_id_param IS NULL
142	        OR s.workspace_id = workspace_id_param
143	    );
144	END;
145	$function$;

147	-- Create function to search similar chunks
148	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_similar_chunks(
149	        query_embedding vector,
150	        match_count integer DEFAULT 5,
151	        workspace_ids uuid [] DEFAULT NULL::uuid []
152	    ) RETURNS TABLE(
153	        chunk_id uuid,
154	        exchange_id uuid,
155	        session_id uuid,
156	        workspace_id uuid,
157	        content text,
158	        similarity double precision,
159	        metadata jsonb
160	    ) LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ BEGIN RETURN QUERY
161	SELECT ec.id as chunk_id,
162	    ec.exchange_id,
163	    e.session_id,
164	    s.workspace_id,
165	    ec.content,
166	    1 - (ce.embedding <=> query_embedding) as similarity,
167	    ec.metadata
168	FROM chunk_embeddings ce
169	    JOIN exchange_chunks ec ON ce.chunk_id = ec.id
170	    JOIN exchanges e ON ec.exchange_id = e.id
171	    JOIN sessions s ON e.session_id = s.id
172	WHERE (
173	        workspace_ids IS NULL
174	        OR s.workspace_id = ANY(workspace_ids)
175	    )
176	ORDER BY ce.embedding <=> query_embedding
177	LIMIT match_count;
178	END;
179	$function$;

220	-- Create utility view for workspace-session summary
221	CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW workspace_sessions_summary AS
222	SELECT 
223	  w.id,
224	  w.project_id,
225	  w.owner_id,
226	  w.name,
227	  w.icon,
228	  w.color,
229	  w.created_at,
230	  w.updated_at,
231	  COUNT(s.id) as session_count,
232	  MAX(s.updated_at) as last_session,
233	  COALESCE(SUM(s.markdown_size), 0) as total_markdown_size
234	FROM workspaces w
235	LEFT JOIN sessions s ON w.id = s.workspace_id
236	GROUP BY w.id, w.project_id, w.owner_id, w.name, w.icon, w.color, w.created_at, w.updated_at;
```

```text
497	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
498	// Cloud Lore — final five-table schema (Phase 1).
499	// This schema is FINAL from P1: Phases 2–4 only write/read columns that already
500	// exist here; no later phase reshapes these tables. P1 writes lore_runs /
501	// lore_run_shards (N=1) / lore_dossiers; lore_forged_skills and lore_watermarks
502	// are present from P1 and written from Phase 2 onward.
503	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
504	
505	// Run + fan-out coordination.
506	export const loreRuns = pgTable(
507	  "lore_runs",
508	  {
509	    id: uuid("id").notNull().defaultRandom().primaryKey(),
510	    ownerId: text("owner_id").notNull(),
511	    status: text("status").notNull(), // queued|sharding|running|judging|done|failed
512	    trigger: text("trigger").notNull(), // manual|cron|nudge
513	    shardCount: integer("shard_count").notNull().default(1),
514	    shardsDone: integer("shards_done").notNull().default(0),
515	    sessionCount: integer("session_count"),
516	    spanCount: integer("span_count"),
517	    watermarkFrom: timestamp("watermark_from", { withTimezone: true }), // [from,to) window claimed
518	    watermarkTo: timestamp("watermark_to", { withTimezone: true }),
519	    startedAt: timestamp("started_at", { withTimezone: true }),
520	    endedAt: timestamp("ended_at", { withTimezone: true }),
521	    error: text("error"),
522	    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true })
523	      .defaultNow()
524	      .notNull(),
525	    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true })
526	      .defaultNow()
527	      .notNull(),
528	  },
529	  (table) => [
530	    index("idx_lore_runs_owner_id").on(table.ownerId),
531	    // Single-writer-per-owner at the DB level: at most ONE non-terminal run per
532	    // owner. Closes the check-then-insert race in triggerLoreRun (the SELECT guard
533	    // is the fast path; this partial unique index is the backstop) independent of
534	    // the Phase-3 debounce DO. Additive — no column reshape.
535	    uniqueIndex("idx_lore_runs_owner_in_progress")
536	      .on(table.ownerId)
537	      .where(sql`status IN ('queued','sharding','running','judging')`),
538	  ]
539	);
540	
541	// One row per concurrent sandbox; claimed atomically via SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.
542	export const loreRunShards = pgTable(
543	  "lore_run_shards",
544	  {
545	    runId: uuid("run_id").notNull(),
546	    shardKey: text("shard_key").notNull(), // e.g. project_id, "cluster:0-31"
547	    scopeKind: text("scope_kind").notNull(), // project|cluster|range
548	    scope: jsonb("scope"),
549	    status: text("status").notNull(), // pending|claimed|running|done|failed
550	    sandboxId: text("sandbox_id"),
551	    sessionCount: integer("session_count"),
552	    spanCount: integer("span_count"),
553	    claimedAt: timestamp("claimed_at", { withTimezone: true }),
554	    startedAt: timestamp("started_at", { withTimezone: true }),
555	    endedAt: timestamp("ended_at", { withTimezone: true }),
556	    error: text("error"),
557	  },
558	  (table) => [
559	    primaryKey({ columns: [table.runId, table.shardKey] }),
560	    index("idx_lore_run_shards_run_status").on(table.runId, table.status),
```

```text
1	-- Migration: Restructure for workspace ownership
2	
3	-- Start by renaming the projects table to workspaces
4	ALTER TABLE projects RENAME TO workspaces;
5	
6	-- Then update the projects table by renaming our id column to project_id, adding a new ID column, uuid auto generated,
7	-- and adding an owner_id column, type text.  Also add an index for the project_id and owner_id columns.
8	
9	-- Drop the old primary key constraint
10	ALTER TABLE workspaces DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS projects_pkey;
11	
12	ALTER TABLE workspaces RENAME COLUMN id TO project_id;
13	ALTER TABLE workspaces ADD COLUMN id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY;
14	ALTER TABLE workspaces ADD COLUMN owner_id TEXT NOT NULL;
15	CREATE INDEX idx_workspaces_project_id ON workspaces(project_id);
16	CREATE INDEX idx_workspaces_owner_id ON workspaces(owner_id);
17	
18	-- Let's also create a unique constraint across project_id and owner_id
19	ALTER TABLE workspaces ADD CONSTRAINT unique_project_owner UNIQUE (project_id, owner_id);
20	
21	-- Also rename the triggers for the projects tables to workspaces tables
22	ALTER TRIGGER update_projects_updated_at ON workspaces RENAME TO update_workspaces_updated_at;
23	
24	-- From there we need to update the sessions table project_id reference.  We want to rename the column to workspace_id and
25	-- change its type to UUID.  Also add a foreign key constraint to the workspaces table.
26	ALTER TABLE sessions DROP COLUMN project_id;
27	ALTER TABLE sessions ADD COLUMN workspace_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
28	CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_workspace_id ON sessions(workspace_id);
29	
30	-- We also want to update the unique index for sessions on id and workspace_id
31	CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_sessions_workspace_id_id ON sessions(workspace_id, id);
32	
33	-- From there we need to update the user_permissions table project_id reference.  We want to drop the entity_id column and
34	-- add a workspace_id column and a project_id column.  Also add a foreign key constraint to the workspaces table.
35	-- We want to also set a unique constraint across user_id, workspace_id, and project_id.
36	ALTER TABLE user_permissions DROP COLUMN entity_id;
37	ALTER TABLE user_permissions DROP COLUMN entity_type;
38	ALTER TABLE user_permissions DROP COLUMN is_owner;
39	ALTER TABLE user_permissions ADD COLUMN workspace_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
40	ALTER TABLE user_permissions ADD COLUMN project_id TEXT NOT NULL;
41	CREATE INDEX idx_user_permissions_workspace_id ON user_permissions(workspace_id);
42	CREATE INDEX idx_user_permissions_project_id ON user_permissions(project_id);
43	CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_user_permissions_user_id_workspace_id_project_id ON user_permissions(user_id, workspace_id, project_id);
44	
45	-- Add comments for documentation
46	COMMENT ON TABLE workspaces IS 'User specific project workspace of synced AI chat sessions';
47
```

```text
118	func (stats *CloudSyncStats) calculateTimedOut() {
119		finished := stats.SessionsSkipped + stats.SessionsUpdated + stats.SessionsCreated + stats.SessionsErrored
120	
121		// Defensive validation: finished should never exceed attempted
122		if finished > stats.SessionsAttempted {
123			slog.Error("CloudSyncStats counter inconsistency detected",
124				"attempted", stats.SessionsAttempted,
125				"finished", finished,
126				"skipped", stats.SessionsSkipped,

128				"created", stats.SessionsCreated,
129				"errored", stats.SessionsErrored)
130			stats.SessionsTimedOut = 0
131			return
132		}
133	
134		stats.SessionsTimedOut = stats.SessionsAttempted - finished

167	// incrementCategory atomically increments the counter for a given category
168	func (stats *CloudSyncStats) incrementCategory(category syncCategory) {
169		switch category {
170		case categorySkipped:
171			atomic.AddInt32(&stats.SessionsSkipped, 1)
172		case categoryErrored:
173			atomic.AddInt32(&stats.SessionsErrored, 1)
174		case categoryUpdated:
175			atomic.AddInt32(&stats.SessionsUpdated, 1)
176		case categoryCreated:
177			atomic.AddInt32(&stats.SessionsCreated, 1)
178		}
179	}
180	
181	// decrementCategory atomically decrements the counter for a given category
182	func (stats *CloudSyncStats) decrementCategory(category syncCategory) {
183		switch category {
184		case categorySkipped:
185			atomic.AddInt32(&stats.SessionsSkipped, -1)
186		case categoryErrored:
187			atomic.AddInt32(&stats.SessionsErrored, -1)
188		case categoryUpdated:
189			atomic.AddInt32(&stats.SessionsUpdated, -1)
190		case categoryCreated:
191			atomic.AddInt32(&stats.SessionsCreated, -1)
192		}
193	}

195	// shouldReplaceCategory determines if newCategory should replace oldCategory based on precedence
196	// Precedence (highest to lowest): created > updated > errored > skipped
197	func shouldReplaceCategory(oldCategory, newCategory syncCategory) bool {
198		// Created never gets replaced
199		if oldCategory == categoryCreated {
200			return false
201		}
202		// Updated replaces skipped and errored
203		if newCategory == categoryUpdated {
204			return oldCategory == categorySkipped || oldCategory == categoryErrored
205		}
206		// Errored replaces only skipped
207		if newCategory == categoryErrored {
208			return oldCategory == categorySkipped
209		}
210		// Created replaces everything (but we already handled oldCategory == created above)
211		if newCategory == categoryCreated {
212			return true
213		}
214		// Skipped doesn't replace anything
215		return false
216	}
217	
218	// trackSessionInCategory records a session in a category and updates counters atomically
219	// Handles precedence rules and automatically increments/decrements appropriate counters
220	func (stats *CloudSyncStats) trackSessionInCategory(sessionID string, newCategory syncCategory) {
221		for {
222			// Try to load existing category
223			existing, loaded := stats.countedSessions.Load(sessionID)
224	
225			if !loaded {
226				// No existing entry, try to store
227				actual, loaded := stats.countedSessions.LoadOrStore(sessionID, newCategory)
228				if !loaded {
229					// Successfully stored new category - increment counter
230					stats.incrementCategory(newCategory)
231					return
232				}
233				// Someone else stored it first, loop to check precedence
234				existing = actual
235			}
236	
237			oldCategory := existing.(syncCategory)
238	
239			// Check if we should replace the old category
240			if !shouldReplaceCategory(oldCategory, newCategory) {
241				// Don't replace - higher precedence category already exists
242				return
243			}
244	
245			// Try to replace old category with new category
246			if stats.countedSessions.CompareAndSwap(sessionID, oldCategory, newCategory) {
247				// Successfully replaced - decrement old counter and increment new counter
248				stats.decrementCategory(oldCategory)
249				stats.incrementCategory(newCategory)
250				return
251			}
252			// CompareAndSwap failed, someone else modified it, loop again
253		}
254	}

256	// acquireHTTPSemaphore acquires the HTTP semaphore (blocks until available)
257	// Returns a release function that should be called with defer
258	//
259	// No timeout - blocks indefinitely until semaphore is available. Goroutines that don't acquire
260	// before the overall sync timeout (CloudSyncTimeout) are orphaned, but this is acceptable because
261	// the process terminates after sync timeout. The overall timeout handles cleanup and stats reporting.
262	func (syncMgr *SyncManager) acquireHTTPSemaphore(sessionID, requestType string) (releaseFunc func()) {
263		// Block until semaphore slot is available
264		syncMgr.httpSemaphore <- struct{}{}
265	
266		slog.Debug("Acquired HTTP semaphore",
267			"sessionId", sessionID,
268			"requestType", requestType,
269			"currentConcurrency", len(syncMgr.httpSemaphore))
270	
271		releaseFunc = func() {
272			<-syncMgr.httpSemaphore
273			slog.Debug("Released HTTP semaphore",
274				"sessionId", sessionID,
275				"requestType", requestType,
276				"currentConcurrency", len(syncMgr.httpSemaphore))
277		}
278		return releaseFunc
279	}
280	
281	// fetchBulkSessionSizes fetches markdown sizes for all sessions in a project from the SpecStory Cloud API.
282	// This enables batch sync optimization by avoiding individual HEAD requests for each session.
283	//
284	// The function makes a GET request to /api/v1/projects/{projectID}/sessions/sizes with automatic
285	// retry logic (3 attempts with 1 second delay between retries) to handle transient network failures.
286	// This function is only called once during batch sync initialization, so no HTTP semaphore is needed.
287	//
288	// Parameters:
289	//   - projectID: The project identifier (git_id, workspace_id, or directory name)
290	//
291	// Returns:
292	//   - map[string]int: Map of sessionID to markdown content size in bytes. Empty map if project has no sessions.
293	//   - error: Non-nil if all retry attempts fail, including request creation, network, parsing, or API errors.
294	//
295	// The function logs at Debug level for normal operation and Error level for failures. On success, it logs
296	// at Info level with the count of sessions fetched.
297	func (syncMgr *SyncManager) fetchBulkSessionSizes(projectID string) (map[string]int, error) {
298		const maxAttempts = 3
299		const retryDelay = 1 * time.Second
300	
301		apiURL := GetAPIBaseURL() + "/api/v1/projects/" + projectID + "/sessions/sizes"
302	
303		for attempt := 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++ {
304			// Log attempt
305			if attempt == 1 {
306				slog.Debug("Fetching bulk session sizes",
307					"projectId", projectID,
308					"url", apiURL,
309					"attempt", attempt)
310			} else {
311				slog.Debug("Retrying bulk session sizes fetch",
312					"projectId", projectID,
313					"url", apiURL,
314					"attempt", attempt)
315			}
316	
317			// Make GET request
318			req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", apiURL, nil)
319			if err != nil {
320				slog.Error("Failed to create GET request for bulk sizes",
321					"projectId", projectID,
322					"attempt", attempt,
323					"error", err)
324				if attempt < maxAttempts {
325					time.Sleep(retryDelay)
326					continue
327				}
328				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request after %d attempts: %w", maxAttempts, err)
329			}
330	
331			// Add auth headers
332			cloudToken := GetCloudToken()
333			req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+cloudToken)
334			req.Header.Set("User-Agent", GetUserAgent())
335	
336			// Create HTTP client with timeout
337			client := &http.Client{
338				Timeout: 30 * time.Second,
339			}
340	
341			// Execute request
342			resp, err := client.Do(req)
343	
344			if err != nil {
345				slog.Debug("Bulk sizes GET request failed",
346					"projectId", projectID,
347					"attempt", attempt,
348					"error", err)
349				if attempt < maxAttempts {
350					time.Sleep(retryDelay)
351					continue
352				}
353				return nil, fmt.Errorf("GET request failed after %d attempts: %w", maxAttempts, err)
354			}
355	
356			// Read response body
357			defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()
358			respBody, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
359			if err != nil {
360				slog.Error("Failed to read bulk sizes response body",
361					"projectId", projectID,
362					"attempt", attempt,
363					"status", resp.StatusCode,
364					"error", err)
365				if attempt < maxAttempts {
366					time.Sleep(retryDelay)
367					continue
368				}
369				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response body after %d attempts: %w", maxAttempts, err)
370			}
371	
372			// Check status code
373			if resp.StatusCode != 200 {
374				slog.Debug("Bulk sizes GET returned non-200 status",
375					"projectId", projectID,
376					"attempt", attempt,
377					"status", resp.StatusCode,
378					"responseBody", string(respBody))
379				if attempt < maxAttempts {
380					time.Sleep(retryDelay)
381					continue
382				}
383				return nil, fmt.Errorf("GET request returned status %d after %d attempts", resp.StatusCode, maxAttempts)
384			}
385	
386			// Parse JSON response
387			var bulkResponse BulkSizesResponse
388			err = json.Unmarshal(respBody, &bulkResponse)
389			if err != nil {
390				slog.Error("Failed to parse bulk sizes JSON response",
391					"projectId", projectID,
392					"attempt", attempt,
393					"error", err,
394					"responseBody", string(respBody))
395				if attempt < maxAttempts {
396					time.Sleep(retryDelay)
397					continue
398				}
399				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse JSON after %d attempts: %w", maxAttempts, err)
400			}
401	
402			// Check success field
403			if !bulkResponse.Success {
404				slog.Warn("Bulk sizes response indicated failure",
405					"projectId", projectID,
406					"attempt", attempt)
407				if attempt < maxAttempts {
408					time.Sleep(retryDelay)
409					continue
410				}
411				return nil, fmt.Errorf("API returned success=false after %d attempts", maxAttempts)
412			}
413	
414			// Success - log and return
415			sessionCount := len(bulkResponse.Data.Sessions)
416			slog.Info("Fetched bulk session sizes",
417				"projectId", projectID,
418				"sessionCount", sessionCount)
419			return bulkResponse.Data.Sessions, nil
420		}
421	
422		// Should never reach here, but just in case
423		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to fetch bulk sizes after %d attempts", maxAttempts)
424	}

426	// PreloadSessionSizes fetches and caches session sizes for all sessions in a project
427	// This is a blocking call that should be made before syncing multiple sessions
428	// If fetch fails, logs warning and leaves cache nil (enables HEAD request fallback)
429	func (syncMgr *SyncManager) PreloadSessionSizes(projectID string) {
430		if syncMgr == nil {
431			slog.Warn("PreloadSessionSizes called with nil sync manager")
432			return
433		}
434	
435		slog.Debug("Preloading session sizes for batch sync",
436			"projectId", projectID)
437	
438		// Fetch bulk sizes (with retry logic)
439		sizes, err := syncMgr.fetchBulkSessionSizes(projectID)
440		if err != nil {
441			// Log error and leave cache nil to trigger HEAD request fallback
442			slog.Error("Failed to fetch bulk session sizes, will fall back to HEAD requests",
443				"projectId", projectID,
444				"error", err)
445			return
446		}
447	
448		// Store in cache with write lock
449		syncMgr.bulkSizesMu.Lock()
450		defer syncMgr.bulkSizesMu.Unlock()
451		syncMgr.bulkSizes = sizes
452	
453		sessionCount := len(sizes)
454		slog.Info("Preloaded session sizes from server",
455			"projectId", projectID,
456			"sessionCount", sessionCount)
457	}

459	// requiresSync checks if a session needs to be synced to the cloud
460	// Returns true if sync is needed, false if already up-to-date
461	func (syncMgr *SyncManager) requiresSync(sessionID, mdPath, mdContent, projectID string, skipHeadCheck bool) (bool, error) {
462		// Skip HEAD check if requested (caller determined sync is needed)
463		if skipHeadCheck {
464			slog.Debug("Skipping HEAD check (skipHeadCheck=true)",
465				"sessionId", sessionID)
466			return true, nil
467		}
468	
469		// Get size from passed content
470		localSize := len(mdContent)
471	
472		// Check if bulk sizes are preloaded (batch sync mode)
473		syncMgr.bulkSizesMu.RLock()
474		bulkSizes := syncMgr.bulkSizes
475		syncMgr.bulkSizesMu.RUnlock()
476	
477		if bulkSizes != nil {
478			// Bulk sizes are available - use cached data instead of HEAD request
479			serverSize, exists := bulkSizes[sessionID]
480			if !exists {
481				// Session not in bulk sizes map - doesn't exist on server yet
482				slog.Debug("Using preloaded size for sync check: session not on server",
483					"sessionId", sessionID,
484					"localSize", localSize)
485				return true, nil
486			}
487	
488			// Compare sizes
489			needsSync := localSize > serverSize
490			if needsSync {
491				slog.Debug("Using preloaded size for sync check: local is larger",
492					"sessionId", sessionID,
493					"localSize", localSize,
494					"serverSize", serverSize)
495			} else {
496				slog.Info("Session already up-to-date on server (using preloaded sizes), skipping sync",
497					"sessionId", sessionID,
498					"localSize", localSize,
499					"serverSize", serverSize)
500			}
501			return needsSync, nil
502		}
503	
504		// Bulk sizes not available - fall back to HEAD request
505		slog.Debug("Using HEAD request for sync check (no bulk sizes)",
506			"sessionId", sessionID)
507	
508		// Acquire semaphore for HEAD request (blocks until available)
509		release := syncMgr.acquireHTTPSemaphore(sessionID, "HEAD")
510		defer release()
511	
512		// Make HEAD request
513		apiURL := GetAPIBaseURL() + "/api/v1/projects/" + projectID + "/sessions/" + sessionID
514		req, err := http.NewRequest("HEAD", apiURL, nil)
515		if err != nil {
516			slog.Error("Failed to create HEAD request",
517				"sessionId", sessionID,
518				"error", err)
519			return false, err
520		}
521	
522		// Add auth headers
523		cloudToken := GetCloudToken()
524		req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+cloudToken)
525		req.Header.Set("User-Agent", GetUserAgent())
526	
527		// Create HTTP client with shorter timeout for HEAD
528		client := &http.Client{
529			Timeout: 10 * time.Second,
530		}
531	
532		slog.Debug("Cloud sync HEAD request",
533			"sessionId", sessionID,
534			"url", apiURL,
535			"localMarkdownSize", localSize)
536	
537		// Execute request
538		resp, err := client.Do(req)
539		if err != nil {
540			slog.Debug("HEAD request failed, will attempt sync",
541				"sessionId", sessionID,
542				"error", err)
543			return true, nil // Err on side of syncing if HEAD fails
544		}
545		defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()
546	
547		slog.Debug("Cloud sync HEAD response",
548			"sessionId", sessionID,
549			"status", resp.StatusCode,
550			"headers", resp.Header)
551	
552		// Check response
553		if resp.StatusCode == 404 {
554			slog.Debug("Session not found on server, will sync",
555				"sessionId", sessionID)
556			return true, nil
557		}
558	
559		if resp.StatusCode == 200 {
560			serverSizeStr := resp.Header.Get("X-Markdown-Size")
561			if serverSizeStr == "" {
562				slog.Debug("No X-Markdown-Size header, will sync",
563					"sessionId", sessionID)
564				return true, nil
565			}
566	
567			serverSize, err := strconv.Atoi(serverSizeStr)
568			if err != nil {
569				slog.Debug("Invalid X-Markdown-Size header, will sync",
570					"sessionId", sessionID,
571					"headerValue", serverSizeStr,
572					"error", err)
573				return true, nil
574			}
575	
576			if localSize > serverSize {
577				slog.Debug("Local markdown larger than server, will sync",
578					"sessionId", sessionID,
579					"localSize", localSize,
580					"serverSize", serverSize)
581				return true, nil
582			}
583	
584			slog.Info("Session already up-to-date on server, skipping sync",
585				"sessionId", sessionID,
586				"localSize", localSize,
587				"serverSize", serverSize)
588			return false, nil
589		}
590	
591		// For any other status codes, err on side of syncing
592		slog.Debug("Unexpected HEAD response status, will sync",
593			"sessionId", sessionID,
594			"status", resp.StatusCode)
595		return true, nil
596	}

598	// SetClientVersion sets the client version for API requests
599	func SetClientVersion(version string) {
600		clientVersion = version
601	}
602	
603	// GetClientVersion returns the current client version
604	func GetClientVersion() string {
605		return clientVersion
606	}

608	// SetAPIBaseURL sets the base URL for API requests
609	func SetAPIBaseURL(url string) {
610		apiBaseURL = url
611	}
612	
613	// DefaultAPIBaseURL is the production cloud API base URL used when neither the --cloud-url
614	// flag nor the SPECSTORY_CLOUD_URL env var is set.
615	const DefaultAPIBaseURL = "https://cloud.specstory.com"
616	
617	// EnvCloudURL overrides the default cloud API base URL for the whole CLI. The --cloud-url
618	// flag still takes precedence over it; this is the per-shell convenience for pointing at a
619	// dev/staging cloud without passing the flag on every command.
620	const EnvCloudURL = "SPECSTORY_CLOUD_URL"
621	
622	// GetAPIBaseURL returns the base URL for API requests. Precedence, highest first:
623	//  1. the --cloud-url flag (set via SetAPIBaseURL)
624	//  2. the SPECSTORY_CLOUD_URL environment variable
625	//  3. the production default
626	func GetAPIBaseURL() string {
627		if apiBaseURL != "" {
628			return apiBaseURL // explicit --cloud-url flag wins
629		}
630		if env := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(EnvCloudURL)); env != "" {
631			return env
632		}
633		return DefaultAPIBaseURL
634	}
635	
636	// GetUserAgent returns the User-Agent string for API requests
637	func GetUserAgent() string {
638		return fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s SpecStory, Inc.", ClientName, clientVersion)
639	}
640	
641	// getDeviceID generates a unique device ID based on MAC address
642	func getDeviceID() string {
643		// Return cached value if available
644		if deviceID != "" {
645			return deviceID
646		}
647	
648		// Get all network interfaces
649		interfaces, err := net.Interfaces()
650		if err != nil {
651			slog.Warn("Failed to get network interfaces", "error", err)
652			// Fallback to hostname-based ID
653			hostname, _ := os.Hostname()
654			h := sha256.Sum256([]byte("specstory-" + hostname))
655			deviceID = hex.EncodeToString(h[:])
656			return deviceID
657		}
658	
659		// Find the first non-loopback interface with a MAC address
660		for _, iface := range interfaces {
661			if iface.Flags&net.FlagLoopback == 0 && len(iface.HardwareAddr) > 0 {
662				// Hash the MAC address
663				h := sha256.Sum256(iface.HardwareAddr)
664				deviceID = hex.EncodeToString(h[:])
665				slog.Debug("Generated device ID from interface", "interface", iface.Name)
666				return deviceID
667			}
668		}
669	
670		// Fallback if no suitable interface found
671		hostname, _ := os.Hostname()
672		h := sha256.Sum256([]byte("specstory-fallback-" + hostname))
673		deviceID = hex.EncodeToString(h[:])
674		slog.Debug("Using fallback device ID based on hostname")
675		return deviceID
676	}

678	// InitSyncManager initializes the global sync manager
679	func InitSyncManager(enabled bool) {
680		syncManagerMutex.Lock()
681		defer syncManagerMutex.Unlock()
682		globalSyncManager = &SyncManager{
683			enabled:          enabled,
684			silent:           false,
685			httpSemaphore:    make(chan struct{}, MaxConcurrentHTTPRequests),
686			debounceInterval: SessionDebounceInterval,
687		}
688		slog.Debug("Cloud sync manager initialized", "enabled", enabled, "maxConcurrentHTTPRequests", MaxConcurrentHTTPRequests)
689	}

691	// SetSilent configures whether to show user feedback during shutdown
692	func SetSilent(silent bool) {
693		syncManagerMutex.Lock()
694		defer syncManagerMutex.Unlock()
695		if globalSyncManager != nil {
696			globalSyncManager.silent = silent
697		}
698	}

700	// GetSyncManager returns the global sync manager
701	func GetSyncManager() *SyncManager {
702		syncManagerMutex.RLock()
703		defer syncManagerMutex.RUnlock()
704		return globalSyncManager
705	}

707	// performSync executes the actual sync operation (HEAD check + PUT request)
708	func (syncMgr *SyncManager) performSync(sessionID, mdPath, mdContent string, rawData []byte, agentName string, skipHeadCheck bool) {
709		timestamp := time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
710	
711		// Log the sync attempt
712		slog.Info("Cloud sync initiated",
713			"sessionId", sessionID,
714			"mdPath", mdPath,
715			"agentName", agentName,
716			"timestamp", timestamp)
717	
718		// Track that this session attempted to sync (for timeout calculation at shutdown)
719		// Only count each unique session once, even if performSync is called multiple times
720		// (e.g., due to debouncing in run mode triggering multiple syncs for the same session)
721		// Note: We check the map here but don't store yet - trackSessionInCategory() (called
722		// later in this function on every code path) will store the session in the map
723		if _, alreadyTracked := syncMgr.stats.countedSessions.Load(sessionID); !alreadyTracked {
724			atomic.AddInt32(&syncMgr.stats.SessionsAttempted, 1)
725		}
726	
727		// Content is now passed in as parameters, no need to read files
728	
729		// Create sync session data
730		syncData := SyncSession{
731			SessionID:    sessionID,
732			MDPath:       mdPath,
733			JSONLPath:    "", // No longer using file path
734			JSONLContent: rawData,
735			MDContent:    mdContent,
736		}
737	
738		// Read project configuration
739		projectData, err := readProjectConfig()
740		if err != nil {
741			slog.Warn("Cannot sync session to cloud: failed to read project config", "error", err, "sessionId", sessionID)
742			syncMgr.stats.trackSessionInCategory(sessionID, categoryErrored)
743			return
744		}
745	
746		// Determine project ID - use git_id if present, otherwise workspace_id
747		projectID := ""
748		if projectData != nil && projectData.GitID != "" {
749			projectID = projectData.GitID
750		} else if projectData != nil && projectData.WorkspaceID != "" {
751			projectID = projectData.WorkspaceID
752		}
753	
754		// Project ID is required for cloud sync
755		if projectID == "" {
756			slog.Warn("Cannot sync session to cloud: no project ID available", "sessionId", sessionID)
757			syncMgr.stats.trackSessionInCategory(sessionID, categoryErrored)
758			return
759		}
760	
761		// Get project name (use directory name as fallback - this is cosmetic only)
762		projectName := ""
763		if projectData != nil && projectData.ProjectName != "" {
764			projectName = projectData.ProjectName
765		} else {
766			// Fallback to extracting from mdPath for display purposes only
767			dir := filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(mdPath))      // Go up from history to .specstory
768			projectName = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(dir)) // Get the project directory name
769			slog.Debug("No project name in config, using directory name", "projectName", projectName)
770		}
771	
772		// Check if sync is needed using HEAD request
773		shouldSync, err := syncMgr.requiresSync(sessionID, mdPath, mdContent, projectID, skipHeadCheck)
774		if err != nil {
775			slog.Error("Failed to check if sync needed",
776				"sessionId", sessionID,
777				"error", err)
778			// Continue with sync attempt anyway
779		} else if !shouldSync {
780			// Track skipped session with precedence rules
781			syncMgr.stats.trackSessionInCategory(sessionID, categorySkipped)
782			slog.Info("Skipping cloud sync, already up-to-date",
783				"sessionId", sessionID)
784			return
785		}
786	
787		// Extract name from markdown filename (without path or extension)
788		name := filepath.Base(mdPath)
789		if ext := filepath.Ext(name); ext != "" {
790			name = name[:len(name)-len(ext)]
791		}
792	
793		// Create API request
794		metadata := APIRequestMetadata{
795			ClientName:    ClientName,
796			ClientVersion: clientVersion,
797			AgentName:     agentName, // Use the passed-in agent name
798			DeviceID:      getDeviceID(),
799		}
800		apiReq := APIRequest{
801			ProjectID:   projectID,
802			ProjectName: projectName,
803			Name:        name,
804			Markdown:    syncData.MDContent,
805			RawData:     string(syncData.JSONLContent),
806			Metadata:    metadata,
807		}
808	
809		// Marshal to JSON
810		jsonData, err := json.Marshal(apiReq)
811		if err != nil {
812			slog.Error("Cloud sync error marshaling JSON", "sessionId", sessionID, "error", err)
813			return
814		}
815	
816		// Acquire semaphore for PUT request (blocks until available)
817		release := syncMgr.acquireHTTPSemaphore(sessionID, "PUT")
818		defer release()
819	
820		// Make HTTP request
821		apiURL := GetAPIBaseURL() + "/api/v1/projects/" + projectID + "/sessions/" + sessionID
822		req, err := http.NewRequest("PUT", apiURL, bytes.NewBuffer(jsonData))
823		if err != nil {
824			slog.Error("Cloud sync error creating request", "sessionId", sessionID, "error", err)
825			return
826		}
827	
828		// Get cloud token for authorization
829		cloudToken := GetCloudToken()
830		req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+cloudToken)
831		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
832		req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
833		req.Header.Set("User-Agent", GetUserAgent())
834	
835		// Create HTTP client with timeout
836		client := &http.Client{
837			Timeout: 30 * time.Second,
838		}
839	
840		slog.Debug("Cloud sync making API call",
841			"sessionId", sessionID,
842			"url", apiURL,
843			"projectId", projectID,
844			"projectName", projectName,
845			"name", name,
846			"metadata", metadata,
847			"jsonlSize", len(syncData.JSONLContent),
848			"mdSize", len(syncData.MDContent),
849			"deviceId", getDeviceID())
850	
851		// Make the request
852		resp, err := client.Do(req)
853		if err != nil {
854			// Track network/request errors with precedence rules
855			syncMgr.stats.trackSessionInCategory(sessionID, categoryErrored)
856			slog.Error("Cloud sync API error", "sessionId", sessionID, "error", err)
857			return
858		}
859		defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()
860	
861		// Check response status
862		if resp.StatusCode >= 200 && resp.StatusCode < 300 {
863			// Get ETag from response header
864			etag := resp.Header.Get("ETag")
865			slog.Info("Cloud sync completed successfully",
866				"sessionId", sessionID,
867				"status", resp.StatusCode,
868				"etag", etag)
869	
870			// Track as created or updated based on status code with precedence rules
871			if resp.StatusCode == 201 {
872				syncMgr.stats.trackSessionInCategory(sessionID, categoryCreated)
873			} else {
874				syncMgr.stats.trackSessionInCategory(sessionID, categoryUpdated)
875			}
876		} else {
877			// Track as error with precedence rules
878			syncMgr.stats.trackSessionInCategory(sessionID, categoryErrored)
879	
880			// Try to read error response body
881			respBody, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
882			if err != nil {
883				slog.Error("Cloud sync API returned error",
884					"sessionId", sessionID,
885					"status", resp.StatusCode,
886					"bodyReadError", err)
887			} else {
888				slog.Error("Cloud sync API returned error",
889					"sessionId", sessionID,
890					"status", resp.StatusCode,
891					"responseBody", string(respBody))
892			}
893		}
894	}
895	
896	// debouncedSync implements debouncing logic for a session
897	// Always skips HEAD check since we know content just changed in autosave mode
898	func (syncMgr *SyncManager) debouncedSync(sessionID, mdPath, mdContent string, rawData []byte, agentName string) {
899		// Get or create debounce state for this session
900		stateInterface, _ := syncMgr.debounceSessions.LoadOrStore(sessionID, &sessionDebounceState{})
901		state := stateInterface.(*sessionDebounceState)
902	
903		state.mu.Lock()
904		defer state.mu.Unlock()
905	
906		now := time.Now()
907		timeSinceLastSync := now.Sub(state.lastSyncTime)
908	
909		// Check if we can sync immediately (no recent sync or first sync)
910		if state.lastSyncTime.IsZero() || timeSinceLastSync >= syncMgr.debounceInterval {
911			// Sync immediately
912			state.lastSyncTime = now
913			state.pending = nil
914	
915			// Cancel any pending timer
916			if state.timer != nil {
917				state.timer.Stop()
918				state.timer = nil
919			}
920	
921			// Start sync in goroutine (always skip HEAD check in autosave mode)
922			syncMgr.wg.Add(1)
923			atomic.AddInt32(&syncMgr.syncCount, 1)
924			go func() {
925				defer func() {
926					syncMgr.wg.Done()
927					atomic.AddInt32(&syncMgr.syncCount, -1)
928				}()
929				syncMgr.performSync(sessionID, mdPath, mdContent, rawData, agentName, true)
930			}()
931	
932			// Log with timeSinceLastSync only if meaningful (not after cleanup)
933			if state.lastSyncTime.IsZero() {
934				slog.Debug("Cloud sync started immediately",
935					"sessionId", sessionID)
936			} else {
937				slog.Debug("Cloud sync started immediately",
938					"sessionId", sessionID,
939					"timeSinceLastSync", timeSinceLastSync)
940			}
941			return
942		}
943	
944		// Within debounce window - queue or replace pending request
945		state.pending = &pendingSyncRequest{
946			sessionID: sessionID,
947			mdPath:    mdPath,
948			mdContent: mdContent,
949			rawData:   rawData,
950			agentName: agentName,
951		}
952	
953		// Set timer if not already set
954		if state.timer == nil {
955			timeUntilSync := syncMgr.debounceInterval - timeSinceLastSync
956			state.timer = time.AfterFunc(timeUntilSync, func() {
957				syncMgr.flushPendingSync(sessionID)
958			})
959	
960			slog.Debug("Cloud sync queued with new timer",
961				"sessionId", sessionID,
962				"timeUntilSync", timeUntilSync)
963		} else {
964			slog.Debug("Cloud sync queued (replaced pending)",
965				"sessionId", sessionID)
966		}
967	}

969	// flushPendingSync is called by timer to flush a queued sync
970	func (syncMgr *SyncManager) flushPendingSync(sessionID string) {
971		stateInterface, ok := syncMgr.debounceSessions.Load(sessionID)
972		if !ok {
973			return
974		}
975		state := stateInterface.(*sessionDebounceState)
976	
977		state.mu.Lock()
978		defer state.mu.Unlock()
979	
980		// Sync the pending request (timer is only set when pending is non-nil)
981		req := state.pending
982		state.pending = nil
983		state.timer = nil
984	
985		// Guard against nil pending request (defensive programming)
986		if req == nil {
987			slog.Warn("Timer fired but no pending request found",
988				"sessionId", sessionID)
989			syncMgr.debounceSessions.Delete(sessionID)
990			return
991		}
992	
993		// Clean up the session state from the map since we're done with this debounce cycle
994		// If another event comes later, LoadOrStore will create a fresh state
995		syncMgr.debounceSessions.Delete(sessionID)
996	
997		// Start sync in goroutine (always skip HEAD check for debounced syncs)
998		syncMgr.wg.Add(1)
999		atomic.AddInt32(&syncMgr.syncCount, 1)
1000		go func() {
1001			defer func() {
1002				syncMgr.wg.Done()
1003				atomic.AddInt32(&syncMgr.syncCount, -1)
1004			}()
1005			syncMgr.performSync(req.sessionID, req.mdPath, req.mdContent, req.rawData, req.agentName, true)
1006		}()
1007	
1008		slog.Debug("Flushed pending sync after debounce, cleaned up session state",
1009			"sessionId", sessionID)
1010	}

1016		syncMgr.debounceSessions.Range(func(key, value interface{}) bool {
1017			sessionID := key.(string)

1053	// SyncSessionToCloud asynchronously syncs a session to the cloud
1054	// When isAutosaveMode is true (run command), syncs are debounced and skip HEAD checks for efficiency
1055	// When isAutosaveMode is false (manual sync), syncs are immediate with HEAD checks
1056	func SyncSessionToCloud(sessionID string, mdPath string, mdContent string, rawData []byte, agentName string, isAutosaveMode bool) {
1057		syncManagerMutex.RLock()
1058		syncMgr := globalSyncManager
1059		syncManagerMutex.RUnlock()
1060	
1061		if syncMgr == nil || !syncMgr.enabled {
1062			if syncMgr == nil {
1063				slog.Warn("Cloud sync not initialized, skipping sync", "sessionId", sessionID)
1064			} else {
1065				slog.Debug("Cloud sync disabled by flag, skipping sync", "sessionId", sessionID)
1066			}
1067			return
1068		}
1069	
1070		// Check authentication
1071		if !IsAuthenticated() {
1072			slog.Warn("Cloud sync skipped: user not authenticated", "sessionId", sessionID)
1073			return
1074		}
1075	
1076		// Route to debounced or immediate sync based on mode
1077		if isAutosaveMode {
1078			// Autosave mode: debounce syncs and skip HEAD checks
1079			syncMgr.debouncedSync(sessionID, mdPath, mdContent, rawData, agentName)
1080		} else {
1081			// Manual sync mode: immediate sync with HEAD check
1082			syncMgr.wg.Add(1)
1083			atomic.AddInt32(&syncMgr.syncCount, 1)
1084			go func() {
1085				defer func() {
1086					syncMgr.wg.Done()
1087					atomic.AddInt32(&syncMgr.syncCount, -1)
1088				}()
1089				syncMgr.performSync(sessionID, mdPath, mdContent, rawData, agentName, false)
1090			}()
1091		}
1092	}

1094	// getStats loads atomic counters and returns a CloudSyncStats with calculated timeout count.
1095	// This consolidates the pattern of loading counters + calculating timeouts used in multiple shutdown paths.
1096	func (sm *SyncManager) getStats() *CloudSyncStats {
1097		stats := &CloudSyncStats{
1098			SessionsAttempted: atomic.LoadInt32(&sm.stats.SessionsAttempted),
1099			SessionsSkipped:   atomic.LoadInt32(&sm.stats.SessionsSkipped),
1100			SessionsUpdated:   atomic.LoadInt32(&sm.stats.SessionsUpdated),
1101			SessionsCreated:   atomic.LoadInt32(&sm.stats.SessionsCreated),
1102			SessionsErrored:   atomic.LoadInt32(&sm.stats.SessionsErrored),
1103		}
1104		stats.calculateTimedOut()
1105		return stats
1106	}

1108	// Shutdown waits for all cloud sync operations to complete with a timeout and returns statistics
1109	func Shutdown(timeout time.Duration) *CloudSyncStats {
1110		syncManagerMutex.RLock()
1111		sm := globalSyncManager
1112		syncManagerMutex.RUnlock()
1113	
1114		if sm == nil || !sm.enabled {
1115			return nil
1116		}
1117	
1118		// Flush all pending debounced syncs before waiting
1119		sm.flushAllPending()
1120	
1121		// Create a channel to signal when all syncs are done
1122		done := make(chan struct{})
1123		go func() {
1124			sm.wg.Wait()
1125			close(done)
1126		}()
1127	
1128		// Give goroutines a moment to start and check if we have any work
1129		time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
1130	
1131		// Check if all work is already done (e.g., all sessions were skipped)
1132		select {
1133		case <-done:
1134			// All work completed very quickly (likely all skipped)
1135			stats := sm.getStats()
1136			// If we have stats, return them
1137			if stats.SessionsAttempted > 0 {
1138				return stats
1139			}
1140			// No work was done at all
1141			return nil
1142		default:
1143			// Work is still in progress, continue to show countdown
1144		}
1145	
1146		// Create a ticker for countdown updates
1147		ticker := time.NewTicker(1 * time.Second)
1148		defer ticker.Stop()
1149	
1150		// Track elapsed time
1151		start := time.Now()
1152	
1153		// Show initial countdown immediately
1154		if !sm.silent {
1155			fmt.Printf("Waiting for cloud sync to complete... %ds until timeout", int(timeout.Seconds()))
1156		}
1157	
1158		for {
1159			select {
1160			case <-done:
1161				// Ensure countdown is visible for at least 1 second
1162				elapsed := time.Since(start)
1163				if elapsed < 1*time.Second {
1164					time.Sleep(1*time.Second - elapsed)
1165				}
1166	
1167				// All syncs completed - clear the progress line
1168				if !sm.silent {
1169					// Clear the line by printing spaces over it, then return to beginning
1170					fmt.Printf("\r%60s\r", "")
1171				}
1172	
1173				// Return stats
1174				return sm.getStats()
1175			case <-ticker.C:
1176				// Update countdown
1177				elapsed := time.Since(start)
1178				remaining := timeout - elapsed
1179				if remaining <= 0 {
1180					// Timeout reached - clear the progress line
1181					if !sm.silent {
1182						fmt.Printf("\r%60s\r", "")
1183						fmt.Printf("Cloud sync timeout. Some syncs may not have completed.\n")
1184					}
1185					slog.Warn("Cloud sync shutdown timeout", "timeout", timeout)
1186	
1187					// Return partial stats
1188					return sm.getStats()
1189				}
1190				// Show countdown
1191				if !sm.silent {
1192					fmt.Printf("\rWaiting for cloud sync to complete... %ds until timeout", int(remaining.Seconds()))
1193				}
1194			}
1195		}
1196	}
```

```text
174	// generateWorkspaceID generates a workspace ID by hashing the full project path
175	func (m *ProjectIdentityManager) generateWorkspaceID() string {
176		// Get absolute path to ensure consistency
177		absPath, err := filepath.Abs(m.projectRoot)
178		if err != nil {
179			slog.Warn("Failed to get absolute path, using relative path", "error", err)
180			absPath = m.projectRoot
181		}
182	
183		// The TypeScript version hashes the workspace URI, but in our case
184		// we'll hash the absolute path for compatibility. The path is canonicalized first so
185		// the same physical directory yields one id regardless of the casing a caller passes
186		// (os.Getwd may echo a lowercase $PWD; a session's recorded cwd may differ in case).
187		return m.createHash(canonicalizeWorkspacePath(absPath))
188	}
189	
190	// caseInsensitiveFilesystem reports whether the host OS treats paths case-insensitively.
191	// macOS (APFS/HFS+) and Windows (NTFS) are case-insensitive/case-preserving; Linux is
192	// case-sensitive. It is a var so tests can exercise both behaviors. Windows is included
193	// even though the app is built only for macOS/Linux today: the in-flight Windows support
194	// lives on a branch that does not carry this file, so folding case here keeps that branch
195	// from silently reintroducing case-divergent workspace ids when it merges.
196	var caseInsensitiveFilesystem = runtime.GOOS == "darwin" || runtime.GOOS == "windows"
197	
198	// canonicalizeWorkspacePath normalizes a path before it is hashed into a workspace_id. On
199	// a case-insensitive filesystem the same directory can be named with different casing,
200	// which would otherwise hash to different ids for one physical directory; case-folding
201	// makes the id stable. On case-sensitive filesystems the path is left byte-exact, since
202	// there two differently-cased paths are genuinely different directories.
203	func canonicalizeWorkspacePath(path string) string {
204		if caseInsensitiveFilesystem {
205			return strings.ToLower(path)
206		}
207		return path
208	}

210	// generateGitID generates a git ID by finding and hashing the git origin URL
211	func (m *ProjectIdentityManager) generateGitID() (string, error) {
212		gitConfigPath := filepath.Join(m.projectRoot, ".git", "config")
213	
214		// Check if git config exists
215		if _, err := os.Stat(gitConfigPath); err != nil {
216			return "", fmt.Errorf("no git config found: %w", err)
217		}
218	
219		// Read the origin remote URL from the config (shared with the walk-up resolver).
220		originURL := readOriginURL(gitConfigPath)
221		if originURL == "" {
222			return "", fmt.Errorf("no origin URL found in git config")
223		}
224	
225		// Normalize git URLs to ensure HTTPS and SSH URLs for the same repo generate the same ID
226		normalizedURL := m.normalizeGitURL(originURL)
227	
228		return m.createHash(normalizedURL), nil
229	}
230	
231	// normalizeGitURL normalizes a git URL to ensure HTTPS and SSH URLs for the same repo generate the same ID
232	// It extracts the host and repository path, normalizing different URL formats to a common form
233	func (m *ProjectIdentityManager) normalizeGitURL(gitURL string) string {
234		// Remove .git suffix if present
235		normalized := strings.TrimSuffix(gitURL, ".git")
236	
237		// Handle SSH format (git@host:owner/repo or user@host:owner/repo)
238		if strings.Contains(normalized, "@") && strings.Contains(normalized, ":") {
239			// Split by @ to get the host part
240			parts := strings.SplitN(normalized, "@", 2)
241			if len(parts) == 2 {
242				// Split by : to separate host from path
243				hostAndPath := strings.SplitN(parts[1], ":", 2)
244				if len(hostAndPath) == 2 {
245					// Return normalized as "host/path"
246					return hostAndPath[0] + "/" + hostAndPath[1]
247				}
248			}
249		}
250	
251		// Handle HTTPS and other protocol URLs (https://host/owner/repo, git://host/owner/repo, etc.)
252		if strings.Contains(normalized, "://") {
253			// Remove the protocol
254			protocolIndex := strings.Index(normalized, "://")
255			if protocolIndex != -1 {
256				// Return everything after the protocol
257				return normalized[protocolIndex+3:]
258			}
259		}
260	
261		// Handle implicit format (host/owner/repo) - already normalized
262		return normalized
263	}
264	
265	// createHash creates a hash from the input string matching the TypeScript implementation
266	func (m *ProjectIdentityManager) createHash(input string) string {
267		hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(input))
268		fullHash := fmt.Sprintf("%x", hash)
269	
270		// Take first 16 characters and format as UUID-like string
271		truncated := fullHash[:16]
272	
273		// Insert dashes after every 4 characters: xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx
274		formatted := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-%s-%s",
275			truncated[0:4],
276			truncated[4:8],
277			truncated[8:12],
278			truncated[12:16])

334	// IsValidProjectID checks if a string matches the expected project ID format

336	func IsValidProjectID(s string) bool {

338		matched, _ := regexp.MatchString(`^[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}$`, s)

342	// parseGitRemoteURL parses a git remote URL and returns the repository name
343	func (m *ProjectIdentityManager) parseGitRemoteURL(remoteURL string) string {
344		// Remove .git suffix if present
345		withoutDotGit := strings.TrimSuffix(remoteURL, ".git")
346	
347		var repoName string
348	
349		// Case 1: SSH format (git@github.com:owner/repo)
350		if strings.HasPrefix(withoutDotGit, "git@") {
351			// Split by : and get the part after it
352			parts := strings.Split(withoutDotGit, ":")
353			if len(parts) >= 2 {
354				pathParts := strings.Split(parts[1], "/")
355				if len(pathParts) > 0 {
356					repoName = pathParts[len(pathParts)-1]
357				}
358			}
359		} else if matched := regexp.MustCompile(`^(https?|git|git\+ssh)://`).MatchString(withoutDotGit); matched {
360			// Case 2: HTTP-like protocols (http://, https://, git://, git+ssh://)
361			// Remove the protocol part and extract repo name
362			urlParts := strings.Split(withoutDotGit, "/")
363			if len(urlParts) > 0 {
364				repoName = urlParts[len(urlParts)-1]
365			}
366		} else {
367			// Case 3: Implicit HTTPS (github.com/owner/repo)
368			// Match domain/path pattern
369			if matched := regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+/(.+)`).FindStringSubmatch(withoutDotGit); len(matched) > 1 {
370				pathParts := strings.Split(matched[1], "/")
371				if len(pathParts) > 0 {
372					repoName = pathParts[len(pathParts)-1]
373				}
374			}
375		}
376	
377		return repoName
378	}
379	
380	// generateProjectName generates a project name from git remote or directory name
381	func (m *ProjectIdentityManager) generateProjectName() string {
382		// First, try to get from git remote
383		gitConfigPath := filepath.Join(m.projectRoot, ".git", "config")
384		if originURL := readOriginURL(gitConfigPath); originURL != "" {
385			if repoName := m.parseGitRemoteURL(originURL); repoName != "" {
386				return repoName
387			}
388		}
389	
390		// Fallback: use the last component of the project directory
391		return filepath.Base(m.projectRoot)
392	}

394	// GetProjectName returns the project name from the project identity
395	func (m *ProjectIdentityManager) GetProjectName() (string, error) {
396		identity, err := m.ReadProjectIdentity()
397		if err != nil {
398			return "", err
399		}
400		if identity == nil || identity.ProjectName == "" {

405	
406	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
407	// Walk-up identity resolution (shared by ComputeProjectID and the writer).
408	//
409	// The stored .specstory/.project.json fragments a monorepo: it is written per
410	// launch directory, and generateGitID looks for .git at exactly that directory and
411	// never walks up — so a session launched from a subdirectory gets no git_id and a
412	// path-based workspace_id all its own. The resolver below instead walks UP to the
413	// git root and computes identity from there, so every directory inside one repo
414	// resolves to a single project. See docs/SESSIONS-DB.md.
415	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
416	
417	// originRemoteURLRegex captures the origin remote's url value from a git config file.
418	var originRemoteURLRegex = regexp.MustCompile(`\[remote "origin"\][^\[]*url\s*=\s*([^\n\r]+)`)
419	
420	// readOriginURL returns the origin remote URL from a git config file, or "" if the
421	// file is unreadable or has no origin remote.
422	func readOriginURL(gitConfigPath string) string {
423		gitConfig, err := os.ReadFile(gitConfigPath)
424		if err != nil {
425			return ""
426		}
427		matches := originRemoteURLRegex.FindSubmatch(gitConfig)
428		if len(matches) < 2 {
429			return ""
430		}
431		return strings.TrimSpace(string(matches[1]))
432	}
433	
434	// findGitRoot walks up from dir to the nearest ancestor containing a .git entry and
435	// returns it. The .git entry may be a directory (normal clone) or a FILE (git
436	// worktree / submodule); both satisfy the search. Returns false if no .git is found
437	// before the filesystem root. The walk-up is what lets a session launched from a
438	// monorepo subdirectory resolve to the repo's identity.
439	func findGitRoot(dir string) (string, bool) {
440		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(dir); err == nil {
441			dir = abs
442		}
443		dir = filepath.Clean(dir)
444		for {
445			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(dir, ".git")); err == nil {
446				return dir, true
447			}
448			parent := filepath.Dir(dir)
449			if parent == dir {
450				return "", false // reached the filesystem root without finding .git
451			}
452			dir = parent
453		}
454	}
455	
456	// resolveGitConfigPath returns the path to the git config file that holds a root's
457	// remotes, handling both a normal `.git` directory and a `.git` FILE (worktrees /
458	// submodules, whose private gitdir points at a commondir that holds the shared
459	// config). Returns "" when it cannot be resolved.
460	func resolveGitConfigPath(gitRoot string) string {
461		gitPath := filepath.Join(gitRoot, ".git")
462		info, err := os.Stat(gitPath)
463		if err != nil {
464			return ""
465		}
466		if info.IsDir() {
467			return filepath.Join(gitPath, "config")
468		}
469	
470		// `.git` is a file of the form "gitdir: <path>" pointing at the worktree's private
471		// git dir; the shared config lives in the common dir, not that private dir.
472		data, err := os.ReadFile(gitPath)
473		if err != nil {
474			return ""
475		}
476		content := strings.TrimSpace(string(data))
477		if !strings.HasPrefix(content, "gitdir:") {
478			return ""
479		}
480		gitDir := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(content, "gitdir:"))
481		if gitDir == "" {
482			return ""
483		}
484		if !filepath.IsAbs(gitDir) {
485			gitDir = filepath.Join(gitRoot, gitDir)
486		}
487		commonDir := gitDir
488		if cd, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(gitDir, "commondir")); err == nil {
489			c := strings.TrimSpace(string(cd))
490			if !filepath.IsAbs(c) {
491				c = filepath.Join(gitDir, c)
492			}
493			commonDir = filepath.Clean(c)
494		}
495		return filepath.Join(commonDir, "config")
496	}
497	
498	// resolveIdentity computes a project's identity from a starting directory by walking
499	// up to the git root. It reads only git metadata — never any .specstory/.project.json
500	// — so it cannot be fooled by the per-directory identity files that fragment a
501	// monorepo. Returns the git_id (empty when there is no resolvable origin remote), the
502	// workspace_id (hash of the resolved root), the project name, and the resolved root.
503	func resolveIdentity(startDir string) (gitID, workspaceID, name, root string) {
504		root = startDir
505		if gr, ok := findGitRoot(startDir); ok {
506			root = gr
507		}
508	
509		// A zero-state manager rooted at the resolved root reuses the existing hashing /
510		// normalization / repo-name helpers (they do not depend on manager state).
511		rooted := &ProjectIdentityManager{projectRoot: root}
512		workspaceID = rooted.generateWorkspaceID()
513		if cfg := resolveGitConfigPath(root); cfg != "" {
514			if originURL := readOriginURL(cfg); originURL != "" {
515				gitID = rooted.createHash(rooted.normalizeGitURL(originURL))
516				name = rooted.parseGitRemoteURL(originURL)
517			}
518		}
519		if name == "" {
520			name = filepath.Base(root)
521		}
522		return gitID, workspaceID, name, root
523	}
524	
525	// ComputeProjectID resolves the restore-index project identity for a session's
526	// working directory. It walks up to the git root and computes identity fresh,
527	// ignoring any stored .specstory/.project.json (which fragments a monorepo) and
528	// never writing one. Returns the project id (git_id when a remote is resolvable,
529	// else the path-based workspace_id) and the project name.
530	func ComputeProjectID(cwd string) (id, name string, err error) {
531		if strings.TrimSpace(cwd) == "" {
532			return "", "", fmt.Errorf("cannot resolve project id: empty working directory")
533		}
534		gitID, workspaceID, name, _ := resolveIdentity(cwd)
535	
536		// Prefer a resolvable git_id: it hashes the normalized remote URL, not a path, so it is
537		// immune to the case divergence handled below and never fragments a monorepo.
538		if gitID != "" {
539			return gitID, name, nil
540		}
541	
542		// No git remote → use the path-based workspace_id. Prefer an id already persisted in the
543		// launch dir's .project.json so every consumer (reindex, resume, cloud sync) agrees on a
544		// single value, even for projects whose file predates path canonicalization. Only when no
545		// file exists (e.g. a portable session whose recorded cwd is not present locally) do we
546		// fall back to the freshly computed — and now canonical — hash.
547		if stored := persistedWorkspaceID(cwd); stored != "" {
548			return stored, name, nil
549		}
550		if workspaceID == "" {
551			return "", "", fmt.Errorf("cannot resolve project id for %q", cwd)
552		}
553		return workspaceID, name, nil
554	}
555	
556	// persistedWorkspaceID returns the workspace_id recorded in dir's .specstory/.project.json,
557	// or "" when there is no readable file or it carries no workspace_id. The file is read from
558	// the launch directory (where the writer puts it), not the resolved git root.
559	func persistedWorkspaceID(dir string) string {
560		m := &ProjectIdentityManager{projectRoot: dir}
561		identity, err := m.ReadProjectIdentity()
562		if err != nil || identity == nil {
563			return ""
564		}
565		return identity.WorkspaceID
566	}
```

```text
69	By default, 'watch' is for activity from all registered agent providers. Specify a specific agent ID to watch for activity from only that agent.`

126				// Check authentication for cloud sync

132				}
133	
134				// Start provenance engine if enabled (used in later phases for event correlation)
135				provenanceEngine, provenanceCleanup, err := provenance.StartEngine(provenanceEnabled)
136				if err != nil {

139				defer provenanceCleanup()

164	
165				// Track watch command activation
166				analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventWatchActivated, nil)
167	
168				// Create context for graceful cancellation (Ctrl+C handling)
169				// This allows providers to clean up resources when user presses Ctrl+C

171				defer cancel()

173				// Start filesystem watcher for provenance correlation if enabled (uses signal context for Ctrl+C)
174				fsCleanup, err := provenance.StartFSWatcher(ctx, provenanceEngine, cwd)

202				// Session callback for watch mode output
203				sessionCallback := func(providerID string, sess *spi.AgentChatSession) {
204					// Check if markdown file already exists to determine if this is an update or creation
205					fileFullPath := session.BuildSessionFilePath(sess, config.GetHistoryDir(), useUTC)
206					_, fileExistsErr := os.Stat(fileFullPath)
207					fileExists := fileExistsErr == nil
208	
209					// Process the session (write markdown and sync to cloud)
210					// Don't show output during watch mode
211					// This is autosave mode (true)
212					markdownSize, err := session.ProcessSingleSession(ctx, sess, config, session.ProcessingOptions{
213						OnlyCloudSync:      onlyCloudSync,
214						IsAutosave:         true,
215						DebugRaw:           debugRaw,
216						UseUTC:             useUTC,
217						NoTelemetryPrompts: noTelemetryPrompts,
218					})
219					if err != nil {
220						// Log error but continue - don't fail the whole watch
221						// In watch mode, we prioritize keeping the watcher running.
222						// Failed markdown writes or cloud syncs can be retried later via
223						// the sync command, so we just log and continue.
224						slog.Error("Failed to process session update",
225							"sessionId", sess.SessionID,
226							"provider", providerID,
227							"error", err)

229					}
230	
231					// Mirror the markdown write into the restore index in real time.
232					liveIndex.Record(providerID, sess)
233	
234					// Suppress output for existing sessions seen for the first time (initial scan).
235					// New sessions (!fileExists) always get output since they represent real activity.
236					seenMu.Lock()
237					firstSeen := !seenSessions[sess.SessionID]
238					seenSessions[sess.SessionID] = true
239					seenMu.Unlock()
240					if firstSeen && fileExists {
241						return
242					}
243	
244					// Output formatted line to stdout for watch mode
245					if !log.IsSilent() {
246						// Determine if this was an update or creation

249							action = "created"
250						}

252						// Get timestamps from session data

254						endTime := startTime
255						if sess.SessionData != nil && sess.SessionData.UpdatedAt != "" {
256							endTime = sess.SessionData.UpdatedAt
257						}

269									}
270								}
271							}
272						}

274						// Output the formatted line

295							}
296							activityWord := "activities"

299							}
300							promptWord := "prompts"

305								time.Now().Format("15:04:05"),
306								emoji,
307								providerID,
308								truncateSessionID(sess.SessionID),
309								userPrompts,
310								promptWord,
311								agentActivity,
312								activityWord)
313						}
314					}
315	
316					// Push agent events to provenance engine for correlation
317					provenance.ProcessEvents(ctx, provenanceEngine, sess)
318				}
319	
320				return utils.WatchProviders(ctx, cwd, providers, debugRaw, sessionCallback)
321			},
```

```text
49	// CreateReindexCommand builds the `specstory reindex` command: a full, from-scratch
50	// rebuild of the restore index (~/.specstory/sessions.db) of every coding-agent session
51	// SpecStory can find, across all projects and providers. See docs/SESSIONS-DB.md.
52	func CreateReindexCommand() *cobra.Command {
53		cmd := &cobra.Command{
54			Use:   "reindex",
55			Short: "Rebuild the restore index of all known agent sessions",
56			Long: `Rebuild the restore index used by 'specstory resume'.
57	
58	'reindex' enumerates every session across all installed agents and projects and writes a
59	searchable index to ~/.specstory/sessions.db. It is incremental: a session whose native
60	file is unchanged since it was last indexed is skipped, so re-runs are fast. Use --force to
61	re-index everything regardless. The index is a derived cache: it is safe to delete.`,
62			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
63			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
64				force, _ := cmd.Flags().GetBool("force")
65				return runReindex(force)
66			},
67		}
68		cmd.Flags().Bool("force", false, "re-index every session even if unchanged")
69		return cmd
70	}
71	
72	// reindexItem is one unit of work: a session to parse and index. size/mtime are the
73	// native file's stat, captured during the freshness check and reused (no re-stat).
74	type reindexItem struct {
75		agent string
76		prov  spi.Provider
77		ref   spi.GlobalSessionRef
78		size  int64
79		mtime int64
80		isNew bool // no existing index row → writer can skip the standalone-FTS delete
81	}
82	
83	func runReindex(force bool) error {
84		start := time.Now()
85	
86		// Graceful Ctrl+C: stop feeding work, flush what's written, exit cleanly.
87		ctx, cancel := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
88		defer cancel()
89	
90		dbPath, err := sessionindex.DefaultPath()
91		if err != nil {
92			return err
93		}
94		store, err := sessionindex.Open(dbPath)
95		if err != nil {
96			return fmt.Errorf("opening restore index: %w", err)
97		}
98		defer func() { _ = store.Close() }()
99	
100		registry := factory.GetRegistry()
101	
102		// ---- Phase 1: enumerate every provider concurrently, then dedup ----
103		ids, provs, perProvider := enumerateAll(registry, true)
104	
105		// Existing fingerprints, so unchanged sessions can be skipped (the incremental path).
106		fingerprints := map[string]sessionindex.Fingerprint{}
107		if !force {
108			if fps, err := store.Fingerprints(); err != nil {
109				slog.Warn("reindex: could not load fingerprints, re-indexing all", "error", err)
110			} else {
111				fingerprints = fps
112			}
113		}
114	
115		best, order, foundPerAgent := dedupRefs(ids, provs, perProvider)
116		found := len(order)
117		cache := &projectIDCache{m: map[string]projectIDName{}}
118		work, totals, unchanged := selectWork(order, best, fingerprints, "", force, cache)
119	
120		if found == 0 {
121			fprintln(os.Stderr, "No agent sessions found to index.")
122			return nil
123		}
124		fprintf(os.Stderr, "✓   Found %d sessions  ·  %s\n", found, summarizeCounts(ids, foundPerAgent))
125		if len(work) == 0 {
126			fprintf(os.Stderr, "✓   All %d sessions already up to date.  (%.1fs)\n", found, time.Since(start).Seconds())
127			return nil
128		}
129		if unchanged > 0 {
130			fprintf(os.Stderr, "    %d unchanged · indexing %d…\n\n", unchanged, len(work))
131		} else {
132			fprintln(os.Stderr, "")
133		}
134	
135		// ---- Phase 2+3: parse (worker pool) → write (single goroutine), with live progress ----
136		prog := newReindexProgress(ids, totals)
137		prog.begin()
138		indexedAt := start.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
139		writeErr := processWork(ctx, store, work, cache, indexedAt, min(runtime.NumCPU(), 12), prog)
140		prog.end()
141	
142		if writeErr != nil {
143			return fmt.Errorf("writing restore index: %w", writeErr)
144		}
145	
146		// ---- Summary (counts reflect the WHOLE index, not just this run's work) ----
147		elapsed := time.Since(start)
148		projects, _ := store.ProjectCount(unknownProjectID)
149		unattributed, _ := store.UnattributedCount(unknownProjectID)
150		printReindexSummary(ids, foundPerAgent, dbPath, elapsed, prog.totalDone(), unchanged, projects, unattributed)
```

```text
1	// Package sessionindex implements sessions.db — the machine-level index of every coding-agent
2	// session SpecStory knows about, across all projects and providers. It backs the
3	// `specstory resume` selection UX and is (re)built by `specstory reindex`.
4	//
5	// sessions.db is a DERIVED CACHE over the native session stores: it can be deleted and
6	// fully rebuilt at any time. See docs/SESSIONS-DB.md for the design and schema.
7	package sessionindex
8	
9	import (
10		"context"
11		"database/sql"
12		"errors"
13		"fmt"
14		"os"
15		"path/filepath"

19		_ "modernc.org/sqlite" // SQLite driver (pure Go), same as pkg/provenance
20	)
21	
22	// Connection-pool sizing. Writes (reindex) must serialize on a single connection to
23	// avoid SQLITE_BUSY/deadlocks. The interactive browse path (resume/search) only reads,
24	// so it opens several connections — WAL permits many concurrent readers, which keeps a
25	// single slow full-text query (a broad prefix can take seconds) from starving the UI.
26	const (
27		writerConns = 1
28		readerConns = 4
29	)
30	
31	// Session is one row of the restore index (the `sessions` table), plus Body, which is
32	// indexed into the FTS table rather than stored on the row. See docs/SESSIONS-DB.md.
33	type Session struct {
34		ProjectID    string // resolved git_id (else workspace_id)
35		ProjectName  string
36		Agent        string // provider id: claude, codex, gemini, droid, deepseek, cursor
37		SessionID    string // native session id (uuid)
38		CreatedAt    string // ISO 8601, first turn
39		UpdatedAt    string // ISO 8601, last activity (last turn, else file mtime)
40		UserTurns    int    // count of user prompts
41		TotalTurns   int    // count of all messages
42		Slug         string
43		Name         string
44		NativePath   string // absolute path the provider opens to read this session
45		OriginCwd    string // working directory the session was launched from
46		Size         int64  // native file size, bytes — part of the freshness fingerprint
47		Mtime        int64  // native file mtime, epoch ms — part of the freshness fingerprint
48		IndexVersion int    // reindex logic version that wrote this row — part of the fingerprint
49		IndexedAt    string // ISO 8601, when reindex last wrote this row
50	
51		// Body is the full conversation text, indexed into sessions_fts (not persisted on
52		// the sessions row). Left empty on rows read back out of the index.
53		Body string
54	
55		// IsNew is a write-time hint, not a persisted column: when true, the caller has
56		// determined this (agent, session_id) has no existing index row, so upsertOne can skip
57		// looking up and deleting a prior FTS row before insert. Leave false when unsure — the
58		// lookup-and-delete is then kept, which is always correct (a missing prior row is a no-op).
59		IsNew bool
60	}
61	
62	// Fingerprint identifies an indexed session's freshness: the native file's size and
63	// mtime, plus the reindex logic version that produced the row. reindex skips a session
64	// whose fingerprint is unchanged. See docs/SESSIONS-DB.md.
65	type Fingerprint struct {
66		Size    int64
67		Mtime   int64
68		Version int
69	}
70	
71	// Store is a handle to sessions.db.
72	type Store struct {
73		db *sql.DB
74	}
75	
76	// DefaultPath returns ~/.specstory/sessions.db.
77	func DefaultPath() (string, error) {
78		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
79		if err != nil {
80			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve home directory: %w", err)
81		}
82		return filepath.Join(home, ".specstory", "sessions.db"), nil
83	}
84	
85	// Open opens (or creates) sessions.db for writing — a single serialized connection,
86	// applying WAL + performance pragmas (matching pkg/provenance) and ensuring the schema
87	// exists. Use OpenReader for the read-only interactive browse path.
88	func Open(path string) (*Store, error) {
89		return openWith(path, writerConns)
90	}
91	
92	// OpenReader opens sessions.db for the interactive browse path (resume/search), which
93	// only reads. It allows several concurrent connections so one slow full-text query can't
94	// starve the UI (WAL permits many simultaneous readers). Never write through this handle.
95	func OpenReader(path string) (*Store, error) {
96		return openWith(path, readerConns)
97	}
98	
99	func openWith(path string, maxConns int) (*Store, error) {
100		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
101			return nil, fmt.Errorf("creating database directory: %w", err)
102		}
103	
104		dsn := fmt.Sprintf("file:%s?_pragma=busy_timeout=15000&_pragma=journal_mode(WAL)", filepath.ToSlash(path))
105		db, err := sql.Open("sqlite", dsn)
106		if err != nil {
107			return nil, fmt.Errorf("opening sessions.db: %w", err)
108		}
109	
110		db.SetMaxOpenConns(maxConns)
111		db.SetMaxIdleConns(maxConns)
112	
113		for _, p := range []string{
114			"PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL",
115			"PRAGMA cache_size = -64000",
116			"PRAGMA temp_store = MEMORY",
117			"PRAGMA mmap_size = 268435456",
118			"PRAGMA page_size = 8192",
119		} {
120			if _, err := db.Exec(p); err != nil {
121				_ = db.Close()
122				return nil, fmt.Errorf("setting pragma %q: %w", p, err)
123			}
124		}
125	
126		s := &Store{db: db}
127		if err := s.ensureSchema(); err != nil {
128			_ = db.Close()
129			return nil, fmt.Errorf("ensuring schema: %w", err)
130		}
131		return s, nil
132	}
133	
134	// Close closes the database connection.
135	func (s *Store) Close() error {
136		return s.db.Close()
137	}

145	// FTS row. fts_rowid is write-only — set on insert, read only by SessionBody's join — so it is
146	// deliberately kept out of sessionColumns and the Session struct rather than threaded through
147	// every read path.
148	const sessionInsertColumns = sessionColumns + `, fts_rowid`
```

```text
227	  request: ApiRequest,
228	  projectId: string,
229	  limit: number = 200
230	): Promise<SessionSummary[]> {
231	  // Get session IDs that the user has permission to access
232	  const { data: sessionPermissions, error: sessionPermError } =
233	    await supabaseClient()
234	      .from("user_permissions")
235	      .select("workspace_id")
236	      .eq("user_id", request.userId!)
237	      .eq("project_id", projectId);
238	
239	  if (sessionPermError && sessionPermError.message) {
240	    throw new Error(
241	      `Failed to get session permissions: ${sessionPermError.message}`
242	    );
243	  }
244	
245	  const workspaceIds = sessionPermissions?.map((p) => p.workspace_id) || [];
246	
247	  if (workspaceIds.length === 0) {
248	    throw new Error("No workspace permissions");
249	  }
250	
251	  // Filter sessions by all the workspaceIds that the user has permission to access
252	  // as well as the exchanges in each session.
253	  const { data: sessions, error } = await supabaseClient()
254	    .from("sessions")
255	    .select(
256	      "id, client_id, workspace_id, name, user_title, markdown_size, raw_data_size, created_at, updated_at, started_at, ended_at, metadata, exchanges (id, order_number)"
257	    )
258	    .in("workspace_id", workspaceIds)
259	    .order("ended_at", { ascending: false, nullsFirst: false })
260	    .order("updated_at", { ascending: false })
261	    .limit(limit);
262	
263	  if (error && error.message) {
264	    throw new Error(`Failed to list sessions for project: ${error.message}`);
265	  }
266	
267	  if (!sessions) {
268	    return [];
269	  }
270	
271	  const firstSessionExchangesContent: Record<string, string> = {};
272	  for (const session of sessions) {
273	    if (session.exchanges.length > 0) {
274	      const exchangesRaw = session.exchanges.sort(
275	        (a, b) => a.order_number - b.order_number
276	      );

287	      }
288	      firstSessionExchangesContent[session.id as string] = String(

290	      );
291	    } else {
292	      firstSessionExchangesContent[session.id as string] = "";
293	    }
294	  }
295	
296	  // If we have sessions to return then we want to return the session data as well as the count of exchanges in each session,
```
